systems.tiers: Local Government Authorities' business licences and levies; traders apply for a business licence on it; a module is to be added for street and village executives to register traders, and another for building-based taxes and levies (measures for 2026/27)
national tax administration; to be integrated with TAUSI for direct data exchange

note: The speech names TAUSI as the local government licence and levy system and sets integration measures for 2026/27, but states nothing about council offices' connection, how they reach the system or how many use it.
